metrics.stressGuide: Stress scale guide: 1–3 = Calm & relaxed • 4–6 = Moderate manageable stress • 7–8 = High stress, take time to unwind • 9–10 = Severe stress, consider talking to a counselor or calling 1323
metrics.stressLevelLow: Low (1–3): Calm and relaxed, managing daily tasks comfortably
metrics.stressLevelMid: Moderate (4–6): Some worries on your mind — try taking short mindful breaks
metrics.stressLevelHigh: High (7–8): Noticeable tension building up — make room for a relaxing activity
metrics.stressLevelCritical: Very High (9–10): Intense stress — pause, rest, and consider reaching out to hotline 1323
